name: Lack Of Love
overview: Scripture reveals that a lack of love leads to spiritual decline and broken relationships, as seen when iniquity causes the love of many to grow cold (Matthew 24:12) and when believers are rebuked for abandoning their first love (Revelation 2:4). Christ commands His followers to love one another as He has loved them (John 13:34), demonstrating that genuine love fulfills God's law by doing no harm to others (Romans 13:10). This truth underpins the serious consequences of love's absence, including issues like divorce caused by a lack of love.
